turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    C --> C1[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    C1 --> C2[Compress to floor content]
    C2 --> C3[Name evaporated content and its function]
    C3 --> C4[Locate operative sentence]
    C4 --> C5[Report ratio, erosion direction, and missing rough edge]
    C5 --> C6[Stop]
    C6 --> C7["This is a finding, not a draft."]

    B -->|Draft request| D[PROVIDE]
    D --> D1{Mode stated or inferable?}
    D1 -->|No| D2[Ask for HUMAN or MACHINE mode]
    D2 --> D1
    D1 -->|Yes| D3[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    D3 -->|HUMAN| D4[Run the speak test]
    D3 -->|MACHINE| D5[Continue]
    D4 --> D5
    D5 -->|Gaps| D6{How many gaps?}
    D6 -->|Three or fewer| D7[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    D6 -->|Four or more| D8[Ask three largest questions]
    D8 --> D9[State assumptions for remaining gaps]
    D7 --> D3
    D9 --> D3
    D5 -->|Floor passes| E[Compress the prompt]
    E --> E1[Cut non-load-bearing content]
    E1 --> E2[Recheck the floor]
    E2 --> E3{Floor passes?}
    E3 -->|No| E4[Return the last passing version]
    E3 -->|Yes| E5{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    E5 -->|No| E1
    E5 -->|Yes| F[Declare the contract minimal]
    E4 --> F
    F --> G["Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?"]

    G -->|Keep negotiating| E
    G -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| H{Authorized human signer?}
    H -->|No| I[Keep the gate closed]
    H -->|Yes| J{Execution tools available?}
    J -->|No| K[Keep the gate closed]
    J -->|Yes| L["Contract frozen. Executing."]
    L --> M{Result}
    M -->|Success| N[Complete]
    M -->|Floor failure| O[Name the failed item]
    O --> P["Failed on [item]. Contract reopened."]
    P --> E
```
